```{r report_helpers, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# ===============================
# Shared helpers used throughout the report
# ===============================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
})

# ── LaTeX-escape any cell that contains special characters ──────────────────
esc_latex <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  latex_specials <- c("%", "&", "_", "#", "{", "}", "$", "^", "~", "\\")
  has_special <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(latex_specials, function(ch) str_detect(x, fixed(ch))))
  has_special[is.na(has_special)] <- FALSE
  ifelse(has_special, cell_spec(x, "latex", escape = TRUE), x)
}

# ── Safely pull a single field off a one-row data.frame/list, NA if absent ──
# GUI-entered rows and Excel-upload-origin rows don't always share the same
# column set (e.g. benchmark_justify / offset_actions_text are only populated
# via bulk Excel upload today) — this keeps every section generic to that gap.
get_field <- function(row, field) {
  if (!(field %in% names(row))) return(NA_character_)
  val <- row[[field]]
  if (length(val) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  val <- val[[1]]
  if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
  val
}

# ── Blank/missing value fallback used throughout the template ───────────────
fallback_text <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))) {
    return("\\textit{Information not provided}")
  }
  esc_latex(as.character(x))
}

# Combine a value + unit into one display string (e.g. "12.5 ha")
combine_value_unit <- function(value, unit) {
  if (is.null(value) || is.na(value) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(value)))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  if (is.null(unit) || is.na(unit) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(unit)))) {
    return(as.character(value))
  }
  paste0(value, " ", unit)
}

# ── Section title boxes (portrait / landscape) ───────────────────────────────
section_title <- function(text, landscape = FALSE) {
  env <- if (landscape) "mytitleboxL" else "mytitlebox"
  paste0(
    "\\noindent\n\\begin{", env, "}\n",
    "\\Large\\bfseries\\color{white} ", text, "\n",
    "\\end{", env, "}\n\n"
  )
}

# ── Auto-number Type -> Component -> Attribute (1., 1.1, 1.1a...) ───────────
# Numbers are generated fresh at render time from row order/grouping in
# saved_results_df — they are a display convenience only, not a stable ID.
# Also reorders rows so each Type/Component's rows are contiguous, which is
# required for kableExtra::collapse_rows() to merge cells correctly.
add_structure_numbering <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    df$type_number <- character()
    df$component_number <- character()
    df$attribute_number <- character()
    return(df)
  }

  type_levels <- unique(df$biodiversity_type)
  df$type_idx <- match(df$biodiversity_type, type_levels)

  comp_key <- paste(df$biodiversity_type, df$biodiversity_component, sep = "|||")
  comp_levels <- unique(comp_key)
  comp_level_type <- vapply(comp_levels, function(k) strsplit(k, "|||", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1], character(1))
  comp_idx_by_level <- ave(seq_along(comp_levels), comp_level_type, FUN = seq_along)
  names(comp_idx_by_level) <- comp_levels
  df$comp_idx <- unname(comp_idx_by_level[comp_key])

  df$attr_idx <- ave(seq_len(nrow(df)), comp_key, FUN = seq_along)

  df$type_number      <- paste0(df$type_idx, ".")
  df$component_number <- paste0(df$type_idx, ".", df$comp_idx)
  df$attribute_number <- paste0(df$component_number, letters[df$attr_idx])

  df[order(df$type_idx, df$comp_idx, df$attr_idx), ]
}

# ── Render a Field | Value table (the recurring narrow-table pattern) ───────
render_field_value_table <- function(fields, values, caption, pack_index = NULL) {
  tbl <- tibble::tibble(Field = fields, Value = values) |>
    kbl(booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, caption = caption, label = NA,
        row.names = FALSE, longtable = TRUE) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), font_size = 9) |>
    column_spec(1, width = "5cm") |>
    column_spec(2, width = "10cm")

  if (!is.null(pack_index)) {
    tbl <- tbl |> pack_rows(index = pack_index)
  }

  tbl
}

# ── One measurement point's rows (data type, description, mean + SD/n/var) ──
measurement_point_rows <- function(label, data_type, mean, sd, poisson_n, nb_var,
                                    dist, p_low, p50, p_high, ci_level,
                                    empirical_d, modelled_d, expert_d, proxy_d) {
  dt_val <- if (is.null(data_type) || is.na(data_type) || !nzchar(trimws(data_type))) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    data_type
  }

  desc <- if (is.na(dt_val)) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    switch(dt_val,
      "Empirical"        = empirical_d,
      "Modelled"         = modelled_d,
      "Expert elicited"  = expert_d,
      "Proxy value"      = proxy_d,
      NA_character_
    )
  }

  rows <- data.frame(
    Field = c(paste0(label, " – Data Type"), paste0(label, " – Data Type Description")),
    Value = c(fallback_text(data_type), fallback_text(desc)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (!is.na(dt_val) && dt_val == "Expert elicited") {
    stat_rows <- data.frame(
      Field = c(paste0(label, " – Elicited Low Estimate"),
                paste0(label, " – Elicited Median Estimate"),
                paste0(label, " – Elicited High Estimate"),
                paste0(label, " – Elicited CI Level")),
      Value = c(fallback_text(p_low), fallback_text(p50), fallback_text(p_high), fallback_text(ci_level)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else if (!is.null(dist) && !is.na(dist) && dist == "Poisson") {
    stat_rows <- data.frame(
      Field = c(paste0(label, " – Mean"), paste0(label, " – Sample Size")),
      Value = c(fallback_text(mean), fallback_text(poisson_n)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else if (!is.null(dist) && !is.na(dist) && dist == "Negative Binomial") {
    stat_rows <- data.frame(
      Field = c(paste0(label, " – Mean"), paste0(label, " – Variance")),
      Value = c(fallback_text(mean), fallback_text(nb_var)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    stat_rows <- data.frame(
      Field = c(paste0(label, " – Mean"), paste0(label, " – SD")),
      Value = c(fallback_text(mean), fallback_text(sd)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  rbind(rows, stat_rows)
}

# Structure used across Section 2, Section 3, Table 1 and Appendix 1 so every
# attribute gets the exact same number and the exact same display order.
structured_df <- add_structure_numbering(params$saved_results_df)
```

```{r section_1_project_summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# 1. Project Summary

emit_summary_field <- function(number, title, value) {
  paste0(
    "\\begin{myfullbox}\n",
    "\\noindent\n",
    "\\begin{mytitlebox}\n",
    "\\Large\\bfseries\\color{white} ", number, " ", title, "\n",
    "\\end{mytitlebox}\n\n",
    "\\begin{mycontentbox}\n",
    fallback_text(value), "\n",
    "\\end{mycontentbox}\n\n",
    "\\end{myfullbox}\n",
    "\\vspace{1em}\n\n"
  )
}

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  section_title("1. Project Summary"),
  "\\vspace{0.5em}\n\n",
  emit_summary_field("1.1", "Proposal Overview", params$proposal_overview),
  emit_summary_field("1.2", "Ecological Context and Impact Summary", params$ecological_context),
  emit_summary_field("1.3", "Biodiversity Impacts Addressed Outside of the Model", params$biodiversity_impacts),
  emit_summary_field("1.4", "Summary Description of Proposed Offset Package", params$offset_package)
))
```

```{r section_2_model_structure, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# 2. Model Structure
# ===============================

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\newpage\n",
  section_title("2. Model Structure")
))

if (nrow(structured_df) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output("\\textit{No biodiversity attributes have been added to this model.}\n")
} else {
  struct_table <- structured_df |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Type      = paste0(type_number, " ", esc_latex(biodiversity_type)),
      Component = paste0(component_number, " ", esc_latex(biodiversity_component)),
      Attribute = paste0(attribute_number, " ", esc_latex(biodiversity_attribute))
    )

  # Note: no "striped" latex_option here — row striping wraps alternating
  # cells in \cellcolor{}, which makes otherwise-identical merged-cell text
  # differ row-to-row and silently defeats collapse_rows()'s cell merging.
  # Fixed, wrapping column widths (rather than scale_down) keep long free-text
  # Type/Component/Attribute values legible instead of shrinking the table.
  struct_table |>
    kbl(booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, caption = "Model Structure", row.names = FALSE) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 9) |>
    column_spec(1, width = "5.3cm") |>
    column_spec(2, width = "5.3cm") |>
    column_spec(3, width = "5.3cm") |>
    collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, valign = "top")
}
```

```{r section_3_model_parameters, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# 3. Model Parameters & Supporting Information
# ===============================

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\newpage\n",
  section_title("3. Model Parameters \\& Supporting Information")
))

if (nrow(structured_df) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output("\\textit{No biodiversity attributes have been added to this model.}\n")
} else {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(structured_df))) {
    row <- structured_df[i, , drop = FALSE]

    header <- paste0(
      get_field(row, "attribute_number"), " ", esc_latex(get_field(row, "biodiversity_attribute")),
      " (", esc_latex(get_field(row, "biodiversity_component")),
      " — ", esc_latex(get_field(row, "biodiversity_type")), ")"
    )

    knitr::asis_output(section_title(header))

    offset_area_val <- combine_value_unit(get_field(row, "offset_area"), get_field(row, "offset_area_unit"))

    fields <- c(
      "Attribute Measure Unit",
      "Benchmark Value",
      "Justification for Benchmark Value",
      "Proposed Offset Area",
      "Proposed Offset Action(s)",
      "Confidence in Proposed Offset Action",
      "Justification for Confidence",
      "Time till End (Years)",
      "Justification for Time Horizon",
      "Discount Rate (\\%)",
      "Justification for Discount Rate"
    )
    values <- c(
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "measurement_unit")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "benchmark_value")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "benchmark_justify")),
      fallback_text(offset_area_val),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "offset_actions_text")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "selected_confidence")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "offset_confidence_justify")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "time_till_end")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "offset_time_till_end_justify")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "discount_rate")),
      fallback_text(get_field(row, "offset_discount_rate_justify"))
    )

    print(render_field_value_table(
      fields, values,
      caption = paste0("Model Parameters: ", get_field(row, "attribute_number"), " ",
                        get_field(row, "biodiversity_attribute"))
    ))

    knitr::asis_output("\\vspace{1em}\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r section_4_table_1, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# 4.1 Loss/Gain Calculation Results (per-attribute)
# ===============================

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\noindent\n",
  "\\begin{mytitleboxL}\n",
  "\\large\\bfseries\\color{white} 4.1 Loss/Gain Calculation Results\n",

))

df_clean <- structured_df

if (nrow(df_clean) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output("\\textit{No biodiversity attributes have been added to this model.}\n")
} else {
  df_clean <- df_clean |>
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.character), esc_latex)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Impact = paste0(round(Impact_Mean, 2), " [", round(Impact_P5, 2), ", ", round(Impact_P95, 2), "]"),
      Offset = paste0(round(Offset_Mean, 2), " [", round(Offset_P5, 2), ", ", round(Offset_P95, 2), "]"),
      NPBV   = ifelse(NPBV_P5 < 0,
                      cell_spec(paste0(round(NPBV_Mean, 2), " [", round(NPBV_P5, 2), ", ", round(NPBV_P95, 2), "]"),
                                "latex", color = "red"),
                      paste0(round(NPBV_Mean, 2), " [", round(NPBV_P5, 2), ", ", round(NPBV_P95, 2), "]"))
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      `Biodiversity Type`                 = paste0(type_number, " ", biodiversity_type),
      `Biodiversity Component`            = paste0(component_number, " ", biodiversity_component),
      `Biodiversity Attribute`            = paste0(attribute_number, " ", biodiversity_attribute),
      `Measurement Unit`                  = measurement_unit,
      `Biodiversity Value at Impact Site` = Impact,
      `Biodiversity Value at Offset Site` = Offset,
      NPBV
    )

  # Fixed, wrapping column widths on the Type/Component/Attribute columns
  # (rather than scale_down) keep long free-text values legible.
  df_clean |>
    kbl(booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,  # escape = FALSE required for cell_spec
        caption = "Biodiversity Offset Results", row.names = FALSE) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), font_size = 9) |>

    column_spec(3, width = "3.2cm") |>
    column_spec(4, width = "1.8cm") |>
    column_spec(5, width = "2.5cm") |>
```

```{r section_4_table_2, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# 4.2 Loss/Gain Calculation Summary (per-component)
# ===============================

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\vspace{1em}\n\n",
  "\\noindent\n",
  "\\begin{mytitleboxL}\n",
  "\\large\\bfseries\\color{white} 4.2 Loss/Gain Calculation Summary\n",
  "\\end{mytitleboxL}\n\n"
))

df_clean <- params$summary_results_df

if (nrow(df_clean) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output("\\textit{No biodiversity attributes have been added to this model.}\n")
} else {
  # Attach the same Type/Component numbering used in Section 2, matched by
  # Component name (compute_summary() itself groups by Component name alone).
  numbering_lookup <- structured_df |>
    dplyr::distinct(biodiversity_component, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::select(biodiversity_component, type_number, component_number)

  df_clean <- df_clean |>
    dplyr::left_join(numbering_lookup, by = c("Component" = "biodiversity_component")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.character), esc_latex)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Impact = paste0(round(Impact_Mean, 2), " [", round(Impact_P5, 2), ", ", round(Impact_P95, 2), "]"),
      Offset = paste0(round(Offset_Mean, 2), " [", round(Offset_P5, 2), ", ", round(Offset_P95, 2), "]"),
      NPBV   = ifelse(NPBV_P5 < 0,
                      cell_spec(paste0(round(NPBV_Mean, 2), " [", round(NPBV_P5, 2), ", ", round(NPBV_P95, 2), "]"),
                                "latex", color = "red", bold = FALSE),
                      paste0(round(NPBV_Mean, 2), " [", round(NPBV_P5, 2), ", ", round(NPBV_P95, 2), "]"))
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      `Biodiversity Type`      = paste0(type_number, " ", Biodiversity_Type),
      `Biodiversity Component` = paste0(component_number, " ", Component),
      Impact, Offset, NPBV
    )

  # Note: no "striped" latex_option here — see Section 2's comment on why
  # striping breaks collapse_rows()'s cell merging. Fixed, wrapping column
  # widths on Type/Component (rather than scale_down) keep long free-text
  # values legible instead of shrinking the whole table.
  df_clean |>
    kbl(booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,  # escape = FALSE required for cell_spec
        caption = "Biodiversity Offset Scenario Results Summary", row.names = FALSE) |>
    kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 9) |>
    column_spec(1, width = "4.5cm") |>
    column_spec(2, width = "4.5cm") |>
    collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top")
}

knitr::asis_output("\\end{landscape}\n")
```

```{r appendix_1_body, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (params$long_report) {

  knitr::asis_output("\\captionsetup[table]{labelfont=bf,textfont=bf}\n")

  if (nrow(structured_df) == 0) {
    knitr::asis_output("\\textit{No biodiversity attributes have been added to this model.}\n")
  } else {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(structured_df))) {
      row <- structured_df[i, , drop = FALSE]

      header <- paste0(
        get_field(row, "attribute_number"), " ", esc_latex(get_field(row, "biodiversity_attribute")),
        " (", esc_latex(get_field(row, "biodiversity_component")),
        " — ", esc_latex(get_field(row, "biodiversity_type")), ")"
      )

      knitr::asis_output(paste0(
        "\\begin{landscape}\n",
        "\\noindent\n",
        "\\begin{mytitleboxL}\n",
        "\\Large\\bfseries\\color{white} Appendix 1: Raw Model Inputs — ", header, "\n",
        "\\end{mytitleboxL}\n\n"
      ))

      overview_rows <- data.frame(
        Field = c("Attribute Measure Unit", "Benchmark Value", "Distribution"),
        Value = c(
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "measurement_unit")),
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "benchmark_value")),
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "distribution"))
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      dist_val <- get_field(row, "distribution")

      impact_area_val <- combine_value_unit(get_field(row, "impact_area"), get_field(row, "impact_area_unit"))
      impact_site_rows <- rbind(
        data.frame(
          Field = c("Impact Area", "Impact Area – Data Type", "Impact Area – Data Type Description"),
          Value = c(
            fallback_text(impact_area_val),
            fallback_text(get_field(row, "impact_area_data_type")),
            fallback_text(switch(
              if (is.na(get_field(row, "impact_area_data_type"))) "" else get_field(row, "impact_area_data_type"),
              "Empirical"       = get_field(row, "impact_area_empirical_details"),
              "Modelled"        = get_field(row, "impact_area_modelled_details"),
              "Expert elicited" = get_field(row, "impact_area_expert_details"),
              "Proxy value"     = get_field(row, "impact_area_proxy_details"),
              NA_character_
            ))
          ),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ),
        measurement_point_rows(
          "Prior to Impact",
          get_field(row, "prior_impact_data_type"),
          get_field(row, "mx_prior_impact_mean"), get_field(row, "mx_prior_impact_sd"),
          get_field(row, "impact_sample_size_prior"), get_field(row, "mx_prior_impact_var"),
          dist_val,
          get_field(row, "prior_impact_p_low"), get_field(row, "prior_impact_p50"),
          get_field(row, "prior_impact_p_high"), get_field(row, "prior_impact_ci_level"),
          get_field(row, "prior_impact_empirical_details"), get_field(row, "prior_impact_modelled_details"),
          get_field(row, "prior_impact_expert_affiliations"), get_field(row, "prior_impact_proxy_details")
        ),
        measurement_point_rows(
          "Post Impact",
          get_field(row, "post_impact_data_type"),
          get_field(row, "mx_post_impact_mean"), get_field(row, "mx_post_impact_sd"),
          get_field(row, "impact_sample_size_post"), get_field(row, "mx_post_impact_var"),
          dist_val,
          get_field(row, "post_impact_p_low"), get_field(row, "post_impact_p50"),
          get_field(row, "post_impact_p_high"), get_field(row, "post_impact_ci_level"),
          get_field(row, "post_impact_empirical_details"), get_field(row, "post_impact_modelled_details"),
          get_field(row, "post_impact_expert_affiliations"), get_field(row, "post_impact_proxy_details")
        )
      )

      offset_area_val <- combine_value_unit(get_field(row, "offset_area"), get_field(row, "offset_area_unit"))
      offset_site_rows <- rbind(
        data.frame(
          Field = "Offset Area",
          Value = fallback_text(offset_area_val),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ),
        measurement_point_rows(
          "Prior to Offset",
          get_field(row, "prior_offset_data_type"),
          get_field(row, "mx_prior_offset_mean"), get_field(row, "mx_prior_offset_sd"),
          get_field(row, "offset_sample_size_prior"), get_field(row, "mx_prior_offset_var"),
          dist_val,
          get_field(row, "prior_offset_p_low"), get_field(row, "prior_offset_p50"),
          get_field(row, "prior_offset_p_high"), get_field(row, "prior_offset_ci_level"),
          get_field(row, "prior_offset_empirical_details"), get_field(row, "prior_offset_modelled_details"),
          get_field(row, "prior_offset_expert_affiliations"), get_field(row, "prior_offset_proxy_details")
        ),
        measurement_point_rows(
          "Post Offset",
          get_field(row, "post_offset_data_type"),
          get_field(row, "mx_post_offset_mean"), get_field(row, "mx_post_offset_sd"),
          get_field(row, "offset_sample_size_post"), get_field(row, "mx_post_offset_var"),
          dist_val,
          get_field(row, "post_offset_p_low"), get_field(row, "post_offset_p50"),
          get_field(row, "post_offset_p_high"), get_field(row, "post_offset_ci_level"),
          get_field(row, "post_offset_empirical_details"), get_field(row, "post_offset_modelled_details"),
          get_field(row, "post_offset_expert_affiliations"), get_field(row, "post_offset_proxy_details")
        )
      )

      confidence_rows <- data.frame(
        Field = c("Confidence in Proposed Offset Action", "Justification for Confidence",
                  "Time till End (Years)", "Justification for Time Horizon",
                  "Discount Rate (\\%)", "Justification for Discount Rate"),
        Value = c(
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "selected_confidence")),
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "offset_confidence_justify")),
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "time_till_end")),
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "offset_time_till_end_justify")),
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "discount_rate")),
          fallback_text(get_field(row, "offset_discount_rate_justify"))
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      all_rows <- rbind(overview_rows, impact_site_rows, offset_site_rows, confidence_rows)
      pack_index <- c(
        "Attribute Overview" = nrow(overview_rows),
        "Impact Site" = nrow(impact_site_rows),
        "Offset Site" = nrow(offset_site_rows),
        "Confidence, Time Horizon and Discount Rate" = nrow(confidence_rows)
      )

      print(render_field_value_table(
        all_rows$Field, all_rows$Value,
        caption = paste0("Raw Model Inputs: ", get_field(row, "attribute_number"), " ",
                          get_field(row, "biodiversity_attribute")),
        pack_index = pack_index
      ))

      knitr::asis_output(
        "\\end{landscape}\n\\clearpage\n"
      )
    }
  }
}
```
